title: Decide placement of DID resolution I/O and cache
description: Decision bead: where DID resolution I/O and cache live — a support crate under AGENTS.md L60-68 rules.
acceptance_criteria: Tests use an independent oracle: each assertion cites and quotes the governing draft sentence (file + line) or uses RFC/draft-published vectors; the code under test is never its own oracle. Decision recorded in notes and AGENTS.md.
notes: DECIDED by Mark 2026-10-20: own support crate crate-jmap-did-resolver (per AGENTS.md §Support crates): did:web and did:plc HTTPS fetch, cache, built on the pure helpers in crate-jmap-did-types (did:key derivation, did:web URI-to-URL, document parsing, PLC op-log verification over supplied bytes). Usable by servers and clients. No *-types/*-server crate depends on it. Check crates.io for maintained DID resolver crates first; prefer a thin adapter.
close_reason: Decided by Mark 2026-10-20; decision recorded in notes
